beats.still: a public kiln, fed, in a walled scrap of a city.
lines: The city burned down to a habit.
Survivors walled a scrap of it and named the scrap Hearthveil.
They feed a public kiln so the ash will sleep.
It is not sleeping.

beats.still: the north arch, and three kinds of people leaving it.
lines: Three kinds of people still walk out of the north arch.
A Cinder Warden stands in the heat.
A Reed Caller calls glass out of still water.
A Briar Stalker salts the ground and leaves.

beats.still: the Ashmarch. Cinderwood, the white road, a kiln that still thinks it is a city.
lines: The first road is the Ashmarch.
Cinder, salt, and a kiln that still thinks it is a city.
Veyra tends a fire that should have gone out with that city.
The city went out. She did not.

beats.still: Brinehollow on stilts. Wrapped bells. Glass water.
lines: When Veyra falls, the mere opens.
North of the salt, the water went to glass.
The bells stay wrapped.
Morra listens when they ring.
She keeps the last bell under the water.

beats.still: hooded lamps, black fruit, rows that walk.
lines: When Morra sinks, the roots keep going.
The fruit ripens in the dark. The rows walk.
Sallow sits where the first tree was cut.
He did not agree to be finished.
His crown was grown, not forged.

beats.still: Ashgate, the last warm door, a pale stair of named steps.
lines: If the rows go quiet, the orchard telling is done.
Above it, a pale stair still climbs.
Ashgate is the last warm door.
The steps already have names. Try not to add yours.

beats.still: the First Kiln. A fire under all the other fires.
lines: At the top is the First Kiln.
Mael is what the public kiln was keeping asleep.
They fed Mael and called it sleep.
Mael is awake.

beats.still: a banked kiln, and a warm stone in Ashgate.
lines: If Mael falls, the feeding can stop.
That is the end of the march.
The rift stone in Ashgate goes warm, if you want a harder road.
